# Adstart — TikTok Ads guide

> An independent informational page about getting started with TikTok Ads: creating an advertiser account,
> the new advertiser ad credit tiers, and exploring campaign setup in TikTok Ads Manager.
> This site is not affiliated with, endorsed by or operated by TikTok.

## Key facts

- Site: https://tiktok-ads.online/
- Language: English (en)
- Type: independent informational resource (no services sold, no accounts opened here)
- Registration for a TikTok Ads account happens on TikTok's own website
- New advertiser offer shown on the page: up to $6,000 in ad credits at a $10,000 qualifying spend tier (not guaranteed)
- Last updated: 2026-09-29

## Pages

- [https://tiktok-ads.online/](https://tiktok-ads.online/): full guide — what the new advertiser credit tiers are, how many steps registration takes,
  which Ads Manager tools exist (objectives, audiences, budget, reporting), what to decide before registering,
  and a FAQ with eight questions.

## Sections (anchors on the home page)

- [New advertiser offer](https://tiktok-ads.online/#offer): credit tiers — $200 spend / $200 credit up to $10,000 spend / $6,000 credit
- [How it works](https://tiktok-ads.online/#how-it-works): three steps — create the account on TikTok, add business details, explore campaign setup
- [Before you start](https://tiktok-ads.online/#prepare): the three decisions worth making before spending — account ownership, reading credit terms, picking the metric that counts
- [FAQ](https://tiktok-ads.online/#faq): registration location, required information, campaign cost, minimum budget, creative format, measurement, credit eligibility, affiliation

## FAQ (short answers)

- Where do I register? On TikTok's website — the buttons on the page continue to TikTok's registration flow.
- What information is needed? TikTok guides the advertiser through it; requirements vary by country and business type.
- How much do campaigns cost? Cost depends on the settings chosen and the options available to the account; check current budget and billing details in TikTok Ads Manager.
- Is there a minimum budget? TikTok sets minimum daily budgets by objective, country and currency — the figure is shown in Ads Manager.
- What creative is used? Vertical full-screen short video that feels native to the feed; Ads Manager lists supported formats and specs.
- How are results measured? Ads Manager reports delivery and engagement; conversions need a tracking setup such as the TikTok Pixel or an app SDK.
- Are credits guaranteed? No. TikTok's offer shown during registration and its terms control.
- Is this TikTok's site? No — independent informational page.
